openings.claim: Bind immutable caption/video snapshots to a displayed request/download identity; verify worker inputs before publication.
openings.discriminator: Reversed completion still yields correct pair identification; continued mistakes weaken selection causality.
openings.fit: Uncertain implementation cost; retain delivered artifacts and original captions.
openings.probe: Compare current history with identity display; record requested, consumed and downloaded hashes and identification time.
openings.uncertainty: Editors may not recognize intended pairs; snapshot verification must fit budget.

openings.claim: Separate artifact readiness delays from identification and review delays.
openings.discriminator: Excess time before verified final-pair availability supports scheduling; afterward supports selection/review.
openings.probe: Timestamp final edit, verified availability, selection and review; separate waiting/active work across repeated-save and single-correction tasks.
openings.uncertainty: Small staging sample cannot establish session target or festival capacity.

openings.claim: Cross manifests with newest-pending-generation dispatch; publish captured manifests, advance current pointer only for intended generation, and retain delivered pointer separately.
openings.discriminator: Combined behavior reduces obsolete renders versus manifests alone and identification errors versus coalescing alone; little single-correction benefit expected.
openings.fit: Uncertain queue/publication cost and storage/processing headroom.
openings.probe: Compare baseline, manifest-only, coalescing-only and combined under rapid saves, reversed completions and changed cuts; measure obsolete dispatches, output hashes, errors and timing.
openings.uncertainty: Benefit requires redundant pending jobs; selection/watching may still dominate.

decision: Probe with demonstration footage and two editors on existing private accounts; cap four engineer-days, one editor-day and 80 processing hours/week. Verify embedded-caption playback and retained delivered wording. Then test 30 sessions: >=27 correctly identified within 15 minutes, zero unintended pairs. Synthetic evidence; observed 49 hours does not establish festival capacity.
